title: Odd weight partial sum transcript acceptance
statement: Let the seed be either a Boolean or an index in $[1m\{0,\ldots,m-1\}[0m$, and let a transcript assign an optional Boolean to each of three positions. If the seed is false, or is an index, accept exactly when all three answers are present and the third equals the sum of the first two in $[1m\mathbb{F}_2[0m$. If the seed is true, accept exactly when the first answer is present and equals $1$ in $[1m\mathbb{F}_2[0m$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ determining the seed index set
A seed that is either a Boolean or an index below $m$
A transcript assigning an optional Boolean to each of three positions
